mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1150 thousand units signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, which typically precedes stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1150.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.5% signals active monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates contraction in manufacturing output, which typically reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 143,000 thousand reflects expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 143000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 445,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, which typically precedes higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS > 445000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in core inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.5%) indicates aggressive monetary policy to combat inflation, which typically suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) triggers restrictive monetary policy that increases real interest rates, reducing equity attractiveness and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
